note: Single source of truth for groups, leaf categories, habitats, facts and look-alikes. Read by tools/generate_dataset.py and by the game (app/js/config.js).

tags.transparent: The object is see-through, so the background shows through it.
tags.camouflage: The object has colors and patterns that blend into the background.
tags.low_light: The picture is dark, like deep or murky water.
tags.distant: The object is small and far away.
tags.unusual_angle: The object is tilted, upside down, or seen from an odd direction.
tags.partially_hidden: Part of the object is hidden behind something.
tags.similar_shape: The object is shown in a pose that looks like something from another group.

fish.label: FISH
fish.fact: Fish live in water and breathe with gills. Most have fins and scales. Sharks are fish too!

marine_mammals.label: MARINE MAMMALS
marine_mammals.fact: Marine mammals breathe air, are warm-blooded, and feed their babies milk. Dolphins and whales are mammals, not fish.

mollusks.label: MOLLUSKS
mollusks.fact: Mollusks have soft bodies. Clams and snails have shells. Octopuses and squid have no outside shell.

crustaceans.label: CRUSTACEANS
crustaceans.fact: Crustaceans have a hard shell outside their body and many legs. Crabs, lobsters, and shrimp are crustaceans.

cnidarians.label: CNIDARIANS
cnidarians.fact: Cnidarians are animals with tiny stinging cells. Jellyfish, coral, and sea anemones are all cnidarians. Coral is an animal, not a plant!

echinoderms.label: ECHINODERMS
echinoderms.fact: Echinoderms live only in the sea. Many have a body in five parts. A sea star is an animal, not a fish.

reptiles.label: REPTILES
reptiles.fact: Reptiles breathe air and have dry, scaly skin. Sea turtles and sea snakes are reptiles that live in the ocean.

birds.label: BIRDS
birds.fact: Birds have feathers and wings and lay eggs. Shore birds live near the coast, but they are not ocean animals.

amphibians.label: AMPHIBIANS
amphibians.fact: Amphibians have thin, moist skin and start life in water. Frogs and salamanders live in fresh water, not in the ocean.

worms.label: WORMS
worms.fact: Worms have soft, long bodies and no legs. Some worms live on the sea floor.

sponges.label: SPONGES
sponges.fact: Sponges are simple animals that stay in one place. They clean food out of the water that flows through them.

insects.label: INSECTS
insects.fact: Insects have six legs and three body parts. Insects are arthropods, like crabs and spiders.

arachnids.label: ARACHNIDS
arachnids.fact: Arachnids, like spiders, have eight legs and two body parts. They are arthropods too.

trash.label: OCEAN TRASH
trash.fact: Trash made by people does not belong in the ocean. It can hurt sea animals.

clownfish.label: Clownfish
clownfish.fact: Clownfish live safely among the arms of sea anemones.

shark.label: Shark
shark.fact: Sharks are fish. They breathe with gills and their skeleton is made of bendy cartilage.

seahorse.label: Seahorse
seahorse.fact: Seahorses are fish, even though they swim upright. Dad seahorses carry the babies.

stingray.label: Stingray
stingray.fact: Stingrays are flat fish. They glide along the sandy sea floor.

tuna.label: Tuna
tuna.fact: Tuna are fast fish with strong, streamlined bodies.

eel.label: Eel
eel.fact: Eels are long fish. They have gills and fins, so they are not snakes.

dolphin.label: Dolphin
dolphin.fact: Dolphins are mammals. They breathe air through a blowhole and feed their babies milk.

whale.label: Whale
whale.fact: Whales are the biggest animals on Earth. They are mammals, not fish.

seal.label: Seal
seal.fact: Seals have no outside ears and wriggle on their bellies on land.

sea_lion.label: Sea lion
sea_lion.fact: Sea lions have small outside ears and can walk on their big flippers.

octopus.label: Octopus
octopus.fact: An octopus has eight arms and is very clever. It has no outside shell.

squid.label: Squid
squid.fact: Squid have ten arms and a long, torpedo-shaped body.

clam.label: Clam
clam.fact: A clam has two shells joined by a hinge.

sea_snail.label: Sea snail
sea_snail.fact: Sea snails carry a spiral shell on their back.

crab.label: Crab
crab.fact: Crabs walk sideways on ten legs. Two of the legs are claws.

lobster.label: Lobster
lobster.fact: Lobsters have a long body, big claws, and a strong tail.

shrimp.label: Shrimp
shrimp.fact: Shrimp are small crustaceans with long feelers and a curved body.

jellyfish.label: Jellyfish
jellyfish.fact: Jellyfish have no brain, no bones, and no heart. Their bell is mostly water.

coral.label: Coral
coral.fact: Coral is made of tiny animals called polyps. Coral is an animal, not a plant.

sea_anemone.label: Sea anemone
sea_anemone.fact: A sea anemone looks like a flower, but it is an animal with stinging tentacles.

sea_star.label: Sea star
sea_star.fact: A sea star is not a fish. Most have five arms and can grow a new arm.

sea_urchin.label: Sea urchin
sea_urchin.fact: A sea urchin is covered in sharp spines.

sea_cucumber.label: Sea cucumber
sea_cucumber.fact: Sea cucumbers are soft, bumpy animals that crawl along the sea floor.

sea_sponge.label: Sea sponge
sea_sponge.fact: A sea sponge is an animal full of tiny holes. It stays in one place.

marine_worms.label: Marine worms
marine_worms.fact: Marine worms live on or in the sea floor. Some have colorful feathery parts.

sea_turtle.label: Sea turtle
sea_turtle.fact: Sea turtles are reptiles. They breathe air and come to the beach to lay eggs.

sea_snake.label: Sea snake
sea_snake.fact: Sea snakes are reptiles. They have a flat tail like a paddle and must come up to breathe.

frog.label: Frog
frog.fact: Frogs live in fresh water and near it. They are amphibians, not ocean animals.

toad.label: Toad
toad.fact: Toads have bumpy, dry-looking skin. They live on land near fresh water.

salamander.label: Salamander
salamander.fact: Salamanders are amphibians with long tails. They live in fresh, damp places.

shore_bird.label: Shore bird
shore_bird.fact: Shore birds hunt for food on beaches and over the waves. They are birds, not ocean animals.

coastal_insect.label: Coastal insect
coastal_insect.fact: Insects live on land, including beaches. They have six legs.

spider.label: Spider
spider.fact: Spiders have eight legs. Some live in beach grass and sand dunes.

plastic_bottle.label: Plastic bottle
plastic_bottle.fact: Plastic bottles can float in the sea for a very long time.

plastic_bag.label: Plastic bag
plastic_bag.fact: Sea turtles can mistake floating plastic bags for jellyfish.

fishing_net.label: Fishing net
fishing_net.fact: Lost fishing nets can trap sea animals.

fishing_line.label: Fishing line
fishing_line.fact: Thin fishing line is hard to see and can tangle around animals.

plastic_straw.label: Plastic straw
plastic_straw.fact: Plastic straws are small, but they can hurt sea animals.

food_wrapper.label: Food wrapper
food_wrapper.fact: Food wrappers blow from beaches into the sea.

aluminum_can.label: Aluminum can
aluminum_can.fact: Metal cans can be recycled instead of ending up in the sea.

glass_bottle.label: Glass bottle
glass_bottle.fact: Broken glass can stay on the sea floor for a very long time.

old_fishing_gear.label: Old fishing gear
old_fishing_gear.fact: Old ropes, traps, and hooks are called ghost gear. They keep trapping animals.

other_marine_debris.label: Other marine debris
other_marine_debris.fact: Old shoes, tires, and many other things end up in the sea too.
